name: zovo-gcode-viewer
displayName: GCode Viewer, CNC Viewer & 3D Print Preview
description: G-code viewer and CNC viewer for 3D printing and CNC milling in VS Code. See the toolpath in 3D by feature or speed, step through layers, play the print, check print time and filament, and jump to the line.

gcodeViewer.maxFileMB.description: G-code files up to this size are read. Larger files show a message and are not read.

gcodeViewer.maxMoves.description: Most moves drawn in 3D. Stats and print time still cover the whole file.

enumDescriptions: CNC for .nc, .ngc, .tap and .cnc files and for files with no extrusion. 3D print for the rest.
Always read files as 3D printer G-code.
Always read files as CNC G-code.
gcodeViewer.mode.description: How moves are read and colored. The toolbar can switch it per tab.

gcodeViewer.filamentDiameter.description: Filament diameter in mm, used for the weight estimate.

gcodeViewer.filamentDensity.description: Filament density in g/cm³, used for the weight estimate. PLA is about 1.24, PETG 1.27, ABS 1.04.

gcodeViewer.rapidFeed.description: Speed in mm/min used for G0 rapid moves in the time estimate (CNC files rarely state it).

gcodeViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used GCode Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

gcodeViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with GCode Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Preview 3D printer and CNC G-code in VS Code.

steps.title: Open a G-code file
steps.description:
Click a .gcode or .gco file in the Explorer. Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan and scroll to zoom.
[Find a G-code file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.gcode%22%5D)

media.altText: A cube print in GCode Viewer colored by feature, with the layer slider and print stats.

steps.title: Step through layers and play the print
steps.description: Move the layer slider or press the arrow keys. Press Play to watch the nozzle draw the print. Go to line opens the layer in the text editor.

steps.title: CNC programs
steps.description: Right-click a .nc CNC program and pick "Open in GCode Viewer". It opens in CNC mode. Rapids, cuts, plunges and G2/G3 arcs get their own colors, and the slider steps through Z passes.

steps.title: Filament and size settings
steps.description:
Set the filament diameter and density for the weight estimate, and the largest file to open.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22gcodeViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
